message.content:
A vertical magazine cover features the red title "TEMPO" across the upper third. Below, the large white text "AKHIRNYA MENDUNIA" is positioned on the left. A smaller text block in white reads: "Mantan presiden Joko Widodo menjadi finalis pemimpin terkorup 2024 versi organisasi wartawan investigasi global. Prabowo Subianto dan partai-partai tak membelanya. H.28." At the top, white text reads "Formula Ganjil PPN 12 Persen H.80" and "Lumbung Pangan di Kampung Opung H.92." A barcode, QR code, and price "RP 60.000" are in the top right.

The central illustration depicts a dark blue silhouette of a person from the waist up, facing left. The figure has short hair, a prominent forehead, and a slender neck. One hand is raised near the chin with curled fingers, while the other holds an open, rectangular book or folder. The figure wears a light-blue, collared long-sleeve shirt with rolled sleeves. The figure is set against a large, stylized yellow and orange flame with jagged, flickering edges. Small orange sparks are scattered around the base. The background is a dark, textured navy blue.
